_meta.notes: Deduplicated URL registry from heart canonical_facts.json, mechanisms.json, common_myths.json, product_angles.json, entities.json. Tiers: A=peer-reviewed trial/meta-analysis, B=expert practitioner content (Attia, Dayspring), C=mainstream medical (Mayo/AHA), D=Thai official.

sources.reliability_notes: REDUCE-IT trial — Bhatt DL et al. 2019. Icosapent ethyl 4 g/day reduced MACE 25% (N=8,179, 4.9 yr). Anchor T1 for high-dose EPA
JUPITER trial — Ridker et al. 2008. Rosuvastatin 20 mg reduced major CV events 44% in LDL-normal, hsCRP-elevated (N=17,802)
Sniderman AD et al. 2019 — ApoB particle count vs LDL-C/non-HDL-C for CVD prediction (meta-analysis)
Detrano et al. 2008 MESA — CAC score for CHD risk prediction in 6,722 asymptomatic; landmark for calcium scoring
Official MESA cohort homepage — resource for CAC, Lp(a), ApoB datasets

sources.org: Journal of the American College of Cardiology (JACC)
sources.reliability_notes: Tsimikas S 2017 — Test-in-Context: Lipoprotein(a) as genetic CVD risk marker, ~20% elevated, Mendelian randomization causal
Davies PF 2009 — endothelial shear stress and atherosclerosis at arterial bifurcations (low/oscillatory flow)
McGill HC et al. 1998 — PDAY study, fibrous plaque present in 20-30% of 25-34 year olds at autopsy
WHO 2023 factsheet — CVD causes ~17.9 million deaths/year globally (#1 cause)
USPSTF 2022 — Aspirin for primary prevention, no longer recommended >60 years due to bleeding risk
Dehghan M et al. 2020 — egg intake ~3M pooled, no CVD association up to 1/day in non-diabetics
Madsen CM et al. 2017 — very high HDL (>100 mg/dL) paradoxically associated with higher all-cause mortality (CGPS)
EFSA 2022 scientific opinion — monacolin K (red yeast rice) restricted <3 mg/day due to hepato/myotoxicity
Chen H et al. 2018 — Nattokinase review: fibrinolytic activity, ~9% fibrinogen reduction, modest BP drop, NOT anticoagulant substitute
Gliozzi M et al. 2013 — Bergamot polyphenolic fraction lowers LDL ~24% in 12-week trial (N=77)
Geleijnse JM et al. 2004 Rotterdam Study — vitamin K2 intake >32 μg/day reduced CHD mortality 57% (N=4,807)
Knapen MHJ et al. 2015 — MK-7 180 μg/day × 3 yr reduces arterial stiffness (RCT, N=244)
Ried K 2016 meta-analysis — aged garlic extract reduces systolic BP ~8.7 mmHg in hypertensives (12 RCT)
Budoff MJ et al. 2009 — aged garlic extract slows CAC progression (RCT, 1 year)

sources.org: Journal of the American College of Cardiology / PubMed
sources.reliability_notes: Mortensen SA et al. 2014 Q-SYMBIO trial — CoQ10 300 mg in HFrEF reduced MACE ~43% vs placebo (N=420)
Qureshi et al. 2022 meta-analysis — CoQ10 reduces statin-associated muscle symptoms
Barkhidarian B et al. 2021 meta-analysis — L-citrulline reduces systolic BP ~4.1 mmHg (12 RCT)

sources.org: Evid Based Complement Alternat Med / PubMed (Dong)
sources.reliability_notes: Dong H et al. 2013 meta-analysis — berberine on lipid profile (27 RCT), LDL ~−0.65 mmol/L, TG ~−0.34 mmol/L
Lu Z et al. 2008 CCSPS trial — Xuezhikang (red yeast rice) reduced MACE ~45% post-MI (N=4,870, 4.5 yr)
Ridker PM et al. 2017 CANTOS — canakinumab (IL-1β inhibitor) reduced MACE 15% via inflammation pathway (N=10,061)
Yusuf S et al. 2004 INTERHEART — 9 modifiable risk factors explain 90% of MI worldwide (N=29,972)
The Drive podcast + Outlive book — cardiovascular prevention framework (ApoB, CAC, Lp(a), zone 2)
Attia & Inigo San Millan — zone 2 training for mitochondrial efficiency and CVD prevention
Dayspring lipidology education — ApoB, particle number, lipid subfractions
AHA guidelines + patient-facing CV disease resources — used for mainstream consensus references
ESC guidelines — ApoB as treatment target (2019 dyslipidemia guideline) + Lp(a) once-in-lifetime test
ACC guideline source + JACC journal publisher — US cardiology standards
Master biomedical literature index used across heart domain fact harvesting
